    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    CharAdapter
    Converts a char value to text in XML and back.
    Director
    Represents a film director with personal data and a list of movies.
    DirectorCatalog
    Root object of the XML document that holds the list of directors.
    DirectorClientRunner
    Tests the SOAP web service on application startup using the client generated by the wsimport tool.
    DirectorRepository
    Provides access to director data.
    DirectorService
    SOAP web service that provides information about directors and their movies.
    DirectorServiceImpl
    DirectorService implementation that gets directors from DirectorRepository.
    HtmlXslTransformer
    XslTransformer implementation that transforms XML to HTML.
    JaxwsApplication
    Entry point of the application.
    Movie
    Represents a movie made by a director.
    PdfXslTransformer
    XslTransformer implementation that transforms XML to PDF using an XSL-FO stylesheet and Apache FOP.
    TransformationRunner
    Generates HTML and PDF files from the directors XML on application startup.
    WebServiceConfig
    Publishes the SOAP web service endpoints.
    XmlDirectorRepository
    DirectorRepository implementation that reads directors from an XML file using JAXB.
    XslTransformer
    Transforms an XML document to another format using an XSL stylesheet.
